A ground-truth group that is not complete or has fewer than 10 clean rounds is left out of both spreads (adviser's ruling 1c of the ninth 9 Nov 2026 paste; scripts/cell_floors.py --min-clean-rounds 10). After T3.2d (quantile 0.95, provisional): 2048x1 1.39 (within), 4096x1 7.69 (between), 8192x1 17.76 (within), 16384x1 13.77 and 16384x4 27.59 (within-session only, 'between-session unavailable': T3.2c's 16384 groups had 8 and 2 clean rounds), 32768x1 101.16 ms (between). Beside the 16384 floors, the sensitivity including T3.2a and T3.2b: 111.05 and 441.54 ms; a comparison at 16384 above the floor and inside the sensitivity floor is reported as marginal. Other sensitivities, never used: T3.2a to T3.2d at every cell (4.25, 8.10, 69.49, 111.05, 441.54, 321.53 ms); the short groups' within-session spread kept (16384: 14.19, 25.00 ms). Recomputed before lock; the pooled 19.42 ms is provisional only. Noise floor 6.77% at the provisional 0.95: the largest systematic between-session gap over T3.2a/b, n = 2, not an interval

committed_predictors.status: proposed lock wording (adviser's ruling 3 of the ninth 9 Nov 2026 paste; the researcher's confirmation of the Gate A recommendation, 9 Nov 2026, 19:38 IST)
committed_predictors.wording: The recursion is the predictor under test, as pre-registered (H1), and is not replaced. For P2 and P4, and every later pairing, the committed prediction file holds, per cell and before the workload is timed, both the recursion and the KernelSight-style step form, with the sum, the sum with s_0, the fitted sum and the learned predictor (T2.11; commit.COMPUTED). H1 is scored as written: its primary comparison is the recursion against the fitted sum; the step form, the sum and the learned predictor are secondary comparators; the step form's own error is reported beside the recursion's on every pairing and every arm class, including where it is lower. Neither predictor is chosen after the data. Gate A's failing legs on P1 (leg 1: the step form below the recursion; leg 2: 6 of 35 cells) are limitations, and P1 is never counted as a test.
committed_predictors.code: attnbench/predict/commit.py: COMPUTED = (recursion, sum, sum_plus_s0, step_form), recomputed by verify_bytes; no code change needed
